what: تحوّل نصًا عربيًا إلى WAV على المعالج دون إنترنت ودون مفتاح، بصوت ar_JO-kareem. / Synthesises Arabic narration on CPU, offline and keyless, with the ar_JO-kareem voice.
how: Install piper-tts in a venv, download the voice model (.onnx + .onnx.json) from huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices (ar/ar_JO/kareem/medium, 63 MB), pipe the text in. Output is 22.05 kHz mono; resample to 48 kHz and loudnorm before muxing (VOICE-44). One sentence per line so --sentence-silence places breaths. Ran here: a 10-word Arabic line → 7.43 s WAV at -16.5 LUFS integrated; with --length-scale 1.15 and --sentence-silence 0.35 two sentences → 7.13 s. (code snippet in references/powers/voice-tts.md)
params: voice ar_JO-kareem-medium (1 speaker, 22050 Hz); inference noise_scale 0.667, noise_w 0.8, length_scale 1.0 (1.1–1.2 = slower, calmer); --sentence-silence 0.2–0.5 s; --volume 1.0
license: piper-tts is GPL-3.0-or-later (call it as a CLI, do not vendor its code); the kareem dataset licence is 'see URL' on the model card — check before commercial delivery.
proof: run here 2026-10-16: piper-tts 1.8.0 → ar.wav 7.43 s, -16.5 LUFS

what: سكربت المالك voice.py ينطق النص بأصوات ويندوز المثبتة (Microsoft Naayf ar-SA) ويُخرج مسارًا واحدًا وتوقيت كل سطر. / Owner script voice.py speaks a timed script with installed Windows voices (Microsoft Naayf ar-SA) and writes one track plus per-line timings.
how: PowerShell + SSML prosody under the hood. `python voice.py --list`; `voice.py out.wav --text '…' --voice Naayf --rate -5%`; or `--script lines.json [--seconds 15]` → out.wav + out.json [{t,end,text}] for captions and ducking. Trims silence (|x|>0.004) keeping 20 ms head / 80 ms tail, resamples to 48 kHz stereo, peak 0.89. In a composition mark it `<audio data-role="voice">` so the mux ducks other clips and normalises to -14 LUFS. The Basma editor calls the same voices through the local bridge (GET /api/voices, POST /api/voice {lines:[{t,text}],voice:'Naayf',seconds}). Owner code, but it needs powershell.exe + OneCore → it does NOT run in this Linux container; use VOICE-01 here.
params: default rate −4 % (CLI examples −5 %), pitch +0 %; 48 kHz stereo; peak 0.89; head 20 ms / tail 80 ms

what: محرك محلي مجاني بـ 54 صوتًا في 8 لغات؛ أول حرف من معرّف الصوت يحدد اللغة — ولا صوت عربي فيه. / Free CPU TTS with 54 voices in 8 languages; the voice-id prefix encodes language — no Arabic voice.
how: Prefixes a/b/e/f/h/i/j/p/z = en-US/en-GB/es/fr/hi/it/ja/pt-BR/zh; good voices af_heart, af_nova, am_adam, bf_emma. Python: `pip install kokoro soundfile` (~311 MB model from huggingface.co; non-English needs espeak-ng, not installed here). JS: `npm i kokoro-js` (1.2.1). The HyperFrames wrapper `npx hyperframes tts` is NOT installable here (@hyperframes/cli 404 on npm).
params: speed 0.7–0.8 tutorial · 1.0 natural · 1.1–1.2 upbeat; 24 kHz output
install: pip install kokoro soundfile   # or: npm i kokoro-js

what: حين لا توجد جلسة صوتية، يقرأ التطبيق الرد بصوت الجهاز العربي عبر Web Speech API. / With no live session, the app reads replies aloud with the device's Arabic voice via the Web Speech API.
how: Strip bullets/asterisks first (`text.replace(/[•*]/g,'')`), `speechSynthesis.cancel()` then speak a `SpeechSynthesisUtterance` with `lang='ar-SA'`; onstart/onend toggle the speaking state (drives VOICE-49). Voice quality depends on the viewer's OS and is not capturable by a headless render — never use it for an MP4. (code snippet in references/powers/voice-tts.md)
params: lang ar-SA; default rate/pitch (owner code sets none)

name_ar: أصوات Edge العصبية والمولدات المبنية عليها
what: مولدات تحول ملف مشاهد (YAML أو JSON) إلى فيديو مروي بأصوات Edge مع ترجمة تلقائية، وفي Edge أصوات عربية مصرية وسعودية. / Generators that turn a scenes file (YAML or JSON) into a narrated MP4 with Edge neural voices and auto subtitles; Edge has ar-EG and ar-SA voices.
how: video-guide-creator: YAML (title-card, bullet-points, outro or screencast steps with CSS selectors) → Docker → MP4; brand presets hold colours, voice, language, logo (default en-US-AriaNeural — switch to an ar-* voice). framecraft: scenes.json → Playwright frames → Edge TTS → FFmpeg 1920x1080 with --auto-duration. Here: `pip install edge-tts` works but speech.platform.bing.com answered 400 in the probe, the Docker image is not built and uv/framecraft are external → treat as documented. Transferable idea: a KOSIF YAML → HTML scene generator feeding VOICE-01.
params: default en-US-AriaNeural; Arabic voices exist for ar-EG and ar-SA

what: مقطع MP3 لكل مشهد بنموذج eleven_multilingual_v2 وإعدادات صوت مضبوطة لكل استخدام. / One MP3 per scene via eleven_multilingual_v2 with tuned voice settings per use case.
how: POST /v1/text-to-speech/{voiceId} (or @elevenlabs/elevenlabs-js textToSpeech.convert) with model_id eleven_multilingual_v2 and voice_settings; key in env ELEVENLABS_API_KEY. Then size each scene to its file (VOICE-31: Remotion calculateMetadata sums durations). Presets: narration stability 0.5 / similarity 0.75 / style 0–0.3; conversational 0.4 / 0.6 / 0.3; cloned voice similarity 0.85. 5000 chars per request.
params: stability 0–1, similarity_boost 0–1, style 0–1, speed 0.7–1.2; ≤5000 chars/request

what: جدول يختار نموذج ElevenLabs حسب زمن الاستجابة والتعبير، وصيغة المخرج حسب الوجهة. / Picks the ElevenLabs model by latency vs expressiveness and the output format by destination.
how: flash (~75 ms TTFB) for realtime, turbo (~150 ms), multilingual_v2 (~300 ms) for narration, v3 (~500 ms, 70+ languages incl. Arabic) for maximum expression. flash/turbo cost 0.5 credit/char, v2/v3 1.0. Format: pcm_44100 for editing, mp3_44100_128 (~16 KB/s) for delivery, mp3_22050_32 only for streaming previews.
params: TTFB flash 75 / turbo 150 / v2 300 / v3 500 ms; credits 0.5 vs 1.0 per char

name_ar: تقسيم النص الطويل مع حفظ النبرة
what: يقسم النص الأطول من حد الطلب مع تمرير النص المجاور لكل قطعة كي تتصل النبرة عبر الوصلات. / Splits over-limit scripts while passing neighbouring text so intonation flows across joins.
how: Split on sentence ends below 5000 chars; send previous_text / next_text with each chunk; decode every chunk to WAV and concat the WAVs (or concat with re-encode) — never `-c copy` MP3s, whose frame padding drifts word timings by tens of ms per join (see VOICE-45).
params: chunk < 5000 chars; joins in PCM

what: صوت مخصص من عينات نظيفة قصيرة لمتحدث موافق — عبر ElevenLabs أو HeyGen. / A custom voice from short clean samples of a consenting speaker — ElevenLabs or HeyGen.
how: ElevenLabs: client.voices.add({name,files}) with 1–25 files, ≥30 s total clean speech, no music; then similarity 0.85. HeyGen: heygen-voice.mjs clone uploads base64 mp3/wav, polls until complete (gives up at 120 s), prints the voice id; list/delete supported. Its 14 mocked tests ran green here, the real call needs HEYGEN_ACCESS_TOKEN. Consent first (VOICE-53).
params: min 30 s clean speech; 1–25 samples; mp3 or wav only; 120 s clone deadline

what: يعيد أداء تسجيل بشري بصوت آخر مع الحفاظ على توقيته وانفعاله. / Re-voices a recorded performance in another voice while keeping its timing and emotion.
how: speechToSpeech.convert(voiceId,{audio, model_id:'eleven_english_sts_v2', remove_background_noise:true}); input 1 s–5 min. Because the timing survives, the words.json you already built on the guide take stays valid.
params: input 1 s–5 min; remove_background_noise true

what: محرر بصمة يسجّل التعليق العربي بـ Gemini ويضعه على الخط الزمني، ويغلف PCM بترويسة WAV. / The Basma editor records Arabic narration with Gemini TTS and drops it on the timeline, wrapping PCM as WAV.
how: responseModalities AUDIO + prebuiltVoiceConfig; L16 PCM at 24 kHz wrapped with a 44-byte WAV header; models gemini-3.8-flash-tts (default), 3.8-flash-lite-tts, 2.5-flash-preview-tts; captions re-sync from the voice's voiced stretches. Needs a Gemini API key.
params: 30 voices: Kore, Puck, Charon, Zephyr, Fenrir, Leda, Orus, Aoede, Callirrhoe, Autonoe, Enceladus, Iapetus, Umbriel, Algieba, Despina, Erinome, Algenib, Rasalgethi, Laomedeia, Achernar, Alnilam, Schedar, Gacrux, Pulcherrima, Achird, Zubenelgenubi, Vindemiatrix, Sadachbia, Sadaltager, Sulafat; 24 kHz PCM; temperature ~0.85, top-p ~0.95 for persona reads

what: قبل أن ينطق المحرك، تكتب أنت ملاحظة أداء JSON: النبرة والطاقة والسرعة والطبقة والوقفات والكلمات المشددة وأنسب صوت. / Before the engine speaks you write a JSON performance note: tone, energy, pace, pitch, pauses, stressed words and the best voice.
how: VOICE.direct(text) → {note ≤60 words, voice, pace 2–4 wps, energy 1–10, pitch low|mid|high, stress[]}; the Gemini wrapper prefixes Cairo-colloquial pronunciation rules (ج hard g, ق glottal stop, ث → s/t, ذ → z/d). The direction half needs no key — apply the same JSON to Piper (length_scale from pace) or any engine. (code snippet in references/powers/voice-tts.md)
params: pace 2–4 words/s; energy 1–10; note ≤ 60 words

what: من فكرة، تكتب نصًا قصيرًا بشخصيات، يُنطق كل سطر بصوت متكلمه ثم يُدمج في مسار حوار واحد. / From an idea you write a short multi-persona script; each line is voiced in its speaker's voice and mixed into one track.
how: fromIdea(): Claude JSON {title, logline, speakers[{name,voice,persona}], lines[{speaker,text,delivery,beat}]} with a hook within 2 s and an arc hook → build → peak → turn → resolve; Gemini may critique; per-line TTS from female pools (Kore, Zephyr, Leda, Aoede…) and male pools (Puck, Charon, Fenrir, Orus…); concatenated mix; then the smart montage runs.
params: hook ≤ 2 s; 5-beat arc; one voice per speaker locked for the whole piece

name_en: HeyGen Starfish TTS with word timestamps
what: مزود يعيد طوابع زمنية للكلمات داخل الاستجابة نفسها، فلا حاجة لتفريغ لاحق. / A provider that returns word timestamps in the response itself, so no post-transcription is needed.
how: node heygen-tts.mjs …; provider order in the vendor engine: HeyGen Starfish (timestamps) → ElevenLabs (none) → Kokoro-82M; Gemini as an explicit alternative. Speed is validated before any TTS runs (0, 5, −1 and text are refused). Ran here: 24/26 mocked tests pass (the 2 failures are bundled-SFX path tests, not TTS). Real calls need HEYGEN_ACCESS_TOKEN.
params: speed must be a positive number in range; docs narrator ref. 145–155 wpm, music bed ~−31 LUFS under it

name_en: Unified audio engine (voice + words + BGM + SFX)
what: سكربت واحد يولد التعليق بتوقيت الكلمات والموسيقى والمؤثرات ويسجلها في audio_meta.json للمزامنة والترجمة. / One script generates narration with word timings, background music and SFX cues, recorded in audio_meta.json.
how: node audio.mjs --script SCRIPT.md --storyboard STORYBOARD.md --hyperframes . --out audio_meta.json --voice <id> (run in background); wait-bgm.mjs before render when BGM is still generating. The pattern (one manifest = master clock) is reusable with VOICE-01 + VOICE-32 locally; the script itself needs provider keys.
params: outputs: voice wav, bgm, sfx, audio_meta.json

what: واجهة مستضافة لـ Kokoro وOrpheus وCartesia Sonic عبر REST والبث وWebSocket. / Hosted TTS API for Kokoro, Orpheus and Cartesia Sonic over REST, streaming and WebSocket.
how: together>=2.0: client.audio.speech.create(model, input, voice, response_format) then write_to_file(). Key required.
params: Kokoro $4 / 1M chars · Orpheus $15 / 1M · Sonic-2 $65 / 1M

what: عقد لمزود خارجي: نص بالمشاعر، إكمال حلقة، سكربت مخرج، ووضع صوت (إخراج → اختيار أصوات → توليد) مع ذاكرة نطق وإعادة توليد دور واحد. / Contract for an external provider: Emotion Text, Full Episode Completion, Director Script, and Audio mode (direct → cast → render) with pronunciation memory and selective turn re-render.
how: Stable casting across episodes; re-render only the changed turn; report backend config errors verbatim; songs go to song generation, never to TTS.

what: تحسب عدد الكلمات المسموح لكل مشهد من مدته قبل التوليد. / Computes the allowed word count per scene from its duration before any TTS.
how: English narration 2.5 wps (15 s ≈ 37 words, 30 s ≈ 75, 60 s ≈ 150); direction spec 2.3–2.7 wps with total within ±5 % of target. By genre: ads 150–170 wpm, narration 130–150, meditation 100–120. Scene fill: 3–4 s → 8–12 words (~70 %), 5–6 s → 15–22 (~75 %), 7–8 s → 22–30 (~80 %). Arabic carries fewer words per second than English (longer words, more syllables) — budget ~15–20 % fewer words and measure with the real voice (the Piper test line ran at ~1.35 wps).
params: 2.3–2.7 wps; ±5 % total; ads 150–170 / narration 130–150 / meditation 100–120 wpm

name_ar: السرعة حسب المحتوى — أعد التوليد ولا تمطّ
name_en: Read speed by content — regenerate, never stretch
what: أبطئ للشرح الكثيف وأسرع قليلًا للخطّاف، بتغيير معامل السرعة في المحرك لا بمطّ الملف. / Slower for dense explanation, slightly faster for hooks — change the engine's speed, never time-stretch the file.
how: Speed 0.7–0.8 tutorial · 1.0 natural · 1.1–1.2 upbeat; avoid ≥1.5. Piper's knob is the inverse (length_scale 1.15 = slower). Ran here: same two Arabic sentences with --length-scale 1.15 --sentence-silence 0.35 → 7.13 s; re-generation keeps formants natural where atempo/rubberband stretching smears consonants.
params: speed 0.7–1.2 (avoid ≥1.5); Piper length_scale ≈ 1/speed

what: المحرك يقرأ النطاقات والاختصارات والأرقام حرفيًا؛ اكتب الشكل المنطوق في التعليق واترك الإملاء الحقيقي على الشاشة. / TTS reads domains, acronyms and numbers literally; write the spoken form in narration and keep the real spelling on screen.
how: Keep two files per scene: `say.txt` (to TTS) and `show.txt` (to captions). Pronunciation map per project: '.com' → 'دوت كوم', 'API' → 'إيه بي آي', '$1.9T' → 'قرابة تريليوني دولار', '٢٠٢٦' → 'ألفين وستة وعشرين'. Add tashkeel only on ambiguous words (عَلِم/عِلْم). Then align captions to the spoken words but display show.txt (ARAB captions family). (code snippet in references/powers/voice-tts.md)

what: فكرة واحدة لكل مشهد، ابدأ بالفعل، لا مصطلحات، تباين بعبارات قصيرة، وصف الحدث قبل ظهوره بلحظة. / One idea per scene, lead with the verb, no jargon, short contrast counts, describe an on-screen action just before it happens.
how: If a sentence needs 'and' (و) it is two scenes. Contrast in counts: '24 تبويبًا. نقرة واحدة. 5 مجموعات.' Narrate an action ~0.3–0.5 s before it appears so the eye arrives with the ear. Strong first line (hook within 2 s). Each scene's narration in its own text file feeding TTS and caption timing. The script complements the visuals; it never reads the on-screen text aloud.
params: 1 idea / scene; action narrated 0.3–0.5 s early; hook ≤ 2 s

what: سكربت منطوق: جمل قصيرة، أرقام وعملات وتواريخ كما تُقال، وسوم وقفة وتشديد وسرعة، ومواصفات صوت. / A spoken-style script with pauses, emphasis and rate tags plus a voice profile, for TTS or a human reader.
how: Write vo-script.md (profile: gender, age, tone, dialect, pace) + ssml.xml. Inline markup: [pause 0.5s], *emphasis*, (emotion). Map to engines: SSML <break time='500ms'/> and <prosody rate='-5%'> for Windows/Edge; sentence-silence and length_scale for Piper; voice_settings for ElevenLabs. After generation measure duration, level, peaks and mispronounced words.
params: duration within ±5 %; pauses 0.3–0.8 s

what: ملف تعليق مقفل: ترويسة بالمزود والإعدادات والإخراج، ثم كتلة لكل سطر بالإطار ودليل الزمن وملاحظة الأداء والنص المنطوق. / A locked narration file: header with provider/settings/direction, then one block per line with frame, time guide, delivery note and spoken text.
how: Blocks `## Line N — label (Frame N)` with Time guide, Delivery note and the indented spoken text fed to TTS. Real timing comes from TTS word timestamps (VOICE-32), never from the Time guide.

what: خط نصي أولًا يجعل الصوت المولد طبيعيًا بالمصرية أو الفصحى أو السعودية أو الشامية أو المغربية أو الخليجية. / Text-first pipeline that makes TTS sound native in Egyptian, MSA, Saudi, Levantine, Moroccan or Gulf Arabic.
how: Brief → rewrite for the ear (short sentences, breath points) → pronunciation memory table (written → spoken; phonetic spelling fixes slang) → per-block direction (emotion, energy 1–5, pace, pauses, emphasis) → render only if a provider is exposed (preview first; no paid credits without approval) → measure (kosif_audio_analyze). Never mix dialects inside one block.
params: energy 1–5; one dialect per block

what: الموجز يسجل لغة النص ولهجة الصوت (فصحى، مصري، سعودي، إنجليزي؛ الافتراضي ar-EG) ويمررها إلى STYLE.md. / The brief records on-screen language and voice dialect (fusha, Egyptian, Saudi, English; default ar-EG) and passes it to STYLE.md.
how: brief.language in the fastify-motion-bro CLI; the voice engine and pronunciation map are then chosen from it (ar-SA → Piper/Naayf; ar-EG → Gemini persona VOICE-26).
params: default ar-EG

what: راوٍ مصري دافئ متحمس بقواعد نطق وأرقام مصرية دقيقة. / A warm, energetic Egyptian narrator persona with exact pronunciation and number rules.
how: Fillers sparingly (يا جماعة، بصوا بقى، تمام؟، زي ما انتم شايفين); ج as hard g; ق as glottal stop; ث → s/t; ذ → z/d; natural breaths. Numbers: 11 حداشر, 12 اتناشر, 15 خمستاشر, 100 مية, 1000 ألف; جنيه = geneh. Gemini temperature ~0.85, top-p ~0.95.
params: ≤1 filler per 3 sentences; temperature 0.85; top-p 0.95

what: وصف صوت ثابت في كل مقطع (راوٍ ذكوري عميق جاد بصدى بكرة فيلم قديمة) وجملة واحدة أقل من 20 كلمة لكل مقطع. / An identical voice description in every clip (deep, serious male narrator, slightly reverberant like an old film reel) and one sentence under 20 words per clip.
how: VOICE constant + narrate(topic,i,n) truncated to 19 words, plus projector hum and paper snaps. Locking the description prevents voice drift between generated clips. Ran here: production-profiles test 10/10 pass, asserting <20 words and the VOICE string in every 10 s clip prompt.
params: < 20 words per 10 s clip; same voice string in every prompt

what: جمل تدريب أمرية قصيرة منفصلة عن وصف اللقطة (تحكم في النزول، شد عضلات البطن). / Short imperative coaching lines kept separate from the shot description.
how: COACH array (5 generic) + per-muscle arrays for Abs, Chest, Back (15 lines); one cue per rep phase; keep them ≤ 6 words so they land inside a 2 s movement. Profile tests ran here (10/10).
params: 5 generic + 15 muscle-specific lines; ≤ 6 words each

what: مواصفات تسجيل المعلق البشري حتى يصل الملف صالحًا للمزامنة والمعالجة. / Recording spec for a human voice-over so the file arrives sync- and processing-ready.
how: Cardioid mic at 10–15 cm with a pop filter; peaks ≈ −12 dBFS; 48 kHz / 24-bit WAV; podcast noise floor < −60 dBFS; record room tone 5 s first (feeds afftdn). Then VOICE-39 cleanup, never re-timing.
params: 10–15 cm; peaks −12 dBFS; 48 kHz/24-bit; noise floor < −60 dBFS

what: مهارة المالك لتعلم اللغة بالممارسة؛ تفيد في كتابة تعليق ثنائي اللغة وترجمة سطر بسطر. / Owner skill for practice-based language learning; useful for bilingual narration and line-by-line translation.
how: Load language-coach-arabic-english (SKILL.md + references/sources.md) and follow its numbered steps; instruction-only, no scripts.

what: تولد التعليق أولًا ثم تقيس كل ملف وتحدد مدة المشهد منه بدل العكس. / Generate narration first, measure each file, and size every scene from it — never the reverse.
how: Per scene: dur = ffprobe(vo_n) + 0.3–1.5 s buffer (1.5 s for demo scenes with UI to read). Remotion: calculateMetadata sums the scene durations; HTML: write the start times into the timeline JSON. Ran here: Arabic VO (loudnorm −14) muxed over a 1080x1920/30 fps plate of exactly ffprobe length → verify_video 11/11 PASS, delivered audio 7.430 s vs master 7.430 s. (code snippet in references/powers/voice-tts.md)
params: buffer 0.3–1.5 s; audio vs master ±50 ms
proof: run here 2026-10-16: vo.mp4 verify_video 11/11, 7.430 vs 7.430 s

name_ar: توقيت كلمات التعليق المولد بـ faster-whisper
name_en: Word timings from the generated voice (faster-whisper)
what: تفرّغ الصوت المولد بطوابع زمنية لكل كلمة ثم تحوله إلى words.json لتتزامن الحركة والترجمة. / Transcribe the generated voice with per-word timestamps and convert to words.json so motion and captions sync.
how: pip install faster-whisper; resample to 16 kHz mono f32 and pass the numpy array (in this venv PyAV 19 rejects faster-whisper's open() kwargs, so do not pass a path); WhisperModel('small', device='cpu', compute_type='int8'), language='ar', word_timestamps=True; dump segments → `python3 kosif-tool/tools/words_convert.py ar.whisper.json words.json`. Ran here: 10 words, 0.00 → 7.26 s. Lesson: Whisper split «محليًا» into «محل» + «ين» — always re-attach to the known script (VOICE-33). (code snippet in references/powers/voice-tts.md)
params: 16 kHz mono; model small int8 on CPU (large-v3 for final); key words ≤ 100 ms, others ≤ 150 ms
proof: run here 2026-10-16: faster-whisper 1.2.1 small → words.json 10 words

name_ar: إعادة لصق النص المعروف على توقيت ويسبر
name_en: Re-attach the known script to Whisper timings
what: لأنك كتبت النص بنفسك، اعرض كلماتك أنت واستعمل من ويسبر التوقيت فقط. / Because you wrote the script, display your own words and take only the timing from Whisper.
how: Normalise both sides (strip tashkeel, unify أ/إ/آ → ا, ة → ه, ى → ي); walk script words and greedily consume Whisper tokens until the normalised concatenation matches (handles splits like محل+ين and merges); start = first token start, end = last token end. If drift persists use WhisperX forced alignment (pip install whisperx). Never edit timings by hand, only text.
params: match on normalised text; fall back to WhisperX

what: كل فكرة بصرية تبقى بطول جملتها (~4–6 ث) مع حركات دقيقة مربوطة بالكلمات المفتاحية. / Each visual idea holds for its sentence (~4–6 s) with micro-animations tied to key words.
how: Generate TTS first; one idea per sentence; key-word sync ≤ 100 ms; camera drifts during pauses so the frame never dies (pauses > 1.5 s need movement). Seen: the 60 s cream-paper explainer (~5 s per idea, static ratio ~0.65), the Fusha doodle parable (camera moves in pauses), a 457 s Chinese edge-tts Manim explainer (visuals step per sentence).
params: ~4–6 s per idea; key word ≤ 100 ms; pause > 1.5 s → ambient motion

what: الجملة تبدأ رمادية وتتحول كل كلمة منطوقة إلى الحبر الداكن، والكلمة الحالية داخل صندوق تظليل. / The sentence starts grey, each spoken word turns to ink, and the current word sits in a highlight box.
how: From words.json: all words at ink #8a7b70 (or 25 % opacity ghosts as in the doodle reel), at word.start − 60 ms tween to #1f1b17 over 120 ms; a peach box #f6cf9a slides behind the current word (x/width tween 140 ms outBack). Arabic: whole words only, RTL container (ARAB-01). Doodle variant: key word recoloured orange with a wiggling squiggle underline.
params: lead 60 ms; 120 ms colour tween; ghosts 25 % opacity; box #f6cf9a on #f4eee0

name_en: Typewriter captions on voice word times
what: الكلمات تُكتب بمؤشر رفيع في اللحظة التي ينطقها الصوت، والكلمة المؤكدة بتدرج متوهج. / Words type in with a thin caret exactly as the voice speaks them; the emphasised word lands in a glowing gradient.
how: Seen in a 22 s 1:1 launch film with an ElevenLabs VO over music ducked at the drop: captions typed at the voice word table inside a glass pill, no full stops, key word filled #f06aa8 → #8a6cf5 → #5d8cf7 with a faint glow, slow camera push 1.0 → 1.04 per scene. Build: per word, reveal at word.start, caret blink 530 ms; Arabic types per word not per letter.
params: reveal at word.start; caret blink 530 ms; push 1.0 → 1.04

what: رسم موجة الصوت مع رأس تشغيل يتقدم بينما الرسم التوضيحي يكتمل متزامنًا مع الكلام. / A drawn voice waveform with a progressing playhead while an illustration completes in sync with speech.
how: Pre-compute peaks: `ffmpeg -i vo.wav -ac 1 -ar 100 -f f32le -` → 100 values/s → abs → bars 3 px wide / 2 px gap, height = peak × 60 px, rounded caps, played bars #3b69f3, unplayed #5c5c6f at 30 %; playhead x = t/dur × width. Seen in a 30 s SaaS explainer on #f8f5ec with a photosynthesis diagram synced to the waveform.
params: 100 peaks/s; bar 3 px + gap 2 px; #3b69f3 / #5c5c6f

name_ar: محاضرة مروية: رسم يتقدم مع الجمل
name_en: Narrated lecture: draw-on paced to sentences
what: سبورة يرسم عليها قلم ظاهر عنصرًا تلو الآخر بسرعة التعليق، والترجمة تتبدل كل جملة تحت اللوح. / A whiteboard where a visible marker draws element after element at narration speed, subtitles swapping per sentence below the board.
how: Per narration sentence: one draw-on element (seconds per element = sentence length), marker icon rides the stroke tip and changes cap colour with ink (#1c1c1c, #c42d3f, #2b4a9b, #2f8a5b); eraser wipe between chapters; subtitles 1–2 centred lines. Seen in a 308 s lecture (static ratio 0.945 — narration carries it) and a bilingual-subtitle whiteboard walk-through.
params: 1 element per sentence; subtitle swap per sentence; eraser wipe between chapters

what: قطع الهدير، إزالة ضوضاء خفيفة، دفء وحضور بالمعادل، تخفيف الصفير، وضغط لطيف للمقاطع الناطقة. / High-pass, light denoise, warmth and presence EQ, de-ess and gentle compression for talking clips.
how: Owner chain in reel.py (identical in kosif-studio, kosif-one and kosif-montage-motion). Ran here on a test signal + loudnorm → −15.9 LUFS integrated, 48 kHz. (code snippet in references/powers/voice-tts.md)
params: HPF 70 Hz; afftdn nr 6 nf −42; +1.2 dB @220 Hz; +2.2 dB @3.2 kHz (w 1.4); −1 dB @9 kHz; deesser i 0.35; comp thr 0.12 ratio 2.5 att 10 ms rel 160 ms makeup 1.6

what: تشخيص العرض أولًا ثم إصلاح واحد: الطنين، الطين، الصندوقية، الحدة، الوضوح. / Diagnose the symptom first, then one fix: rumble, mud, boxiness, harshness, clarity.
how: Vendor presets voice-clean (rumble → mud → even loudness → clarity → peak ceiling), voice-broadcast (+ boxiness, air, warmth), voice-warm (+ weight); singles rumble-cut, room-gate, boom-tame, harsh-tame. The HyperFrames fx-chain is not installable here, so apply the same numbers as ffmpeg `equalizer=f=…:t=q:w=Q:g=…`.
params: boom 200 Hz −4 dB Q1.4; mud 250 Hz −3 dB Q1.2; boxiness 400 Hz −3 dB Q1.4; clarity 3 kHz +2.5 dB Q1; harshness 3.2 kHz −3 dB Q1.6; rumble HPF 80 Hz

what: تلوين متعمد للصوت: هاتف، راديو AM، مكبر صوت، شريط قديم، نداء عام، إنتركم — واحد فقط في كل مرة. / Deliberate voice styling: telephone, AM radio, megaphone, lo-fi tape, PA system, intercom — never stack two.
how: Vendor names 7 presets (telephone, radio-am, megaphone, lofi-tape, pa-system, intercom, doofus-worble) for its fx-chain; the ffmpeg equivalents below rendered here on the Piper Arabic line (telephone 7.43 s, megaphone 7.47 s, room 7.57 s). (code snippet in references/powers/voice-tts.md)
params: telephone HPF 300 / LPF 3400 + comp 4:1; megaphone HPF 500 / LPF 4000 + acrusher 10-bit mix 0.25 + 40 ms slap; room aecho 60|140 ms
proof: run here 2026-10-16: tel.wav / mega.wav / reverb.wav rendered

name_ar: مختبر الصوت: عزل الصوت وفصل الموسيقى
what: يعزل الكلام بـ RNNoise + إزالة ضوضاء FFT، أو يلغي الموسيقى من المركز، بخمسة أوضاع. / Isolates speech with RNNoise + FFT denoise, or centre-cancels music, in five modes.
how: `python scripts/kmotion.py audiolab FILE --mode voice|music|both|novoice|nomusic [--strong]`; centre-cancel works on stereo only; bass below 140 Hz restored after phase cancel. Measured speech/pause contrast 11.2 → 40.9 dB.
params: modes voice|music|both|novoice|nomusic; --strong; bass restore < 140 Hz; contrast 11.2 → 40.9 dB

what: الموسيقى تنخفض تلقائيًا كلما تكلم الصوت وتعود في الوقفات. / The music dips automatically whenever the voice speaks and returns in the pauses.
how: Owner convention: mark `<audio data-role="voice">` and the mux ducks the other clips. Raw ffmpeg: sidechaincompress with the voice as key. Ran here: music bed 220 Hz −31.5 dB before the voice → −48.5 dB under it (≈ 17 dB duck), then loudnorm → −14.8 LUFS. For a gentler bed use ratio 4 (≈ −8 to −12 dB). (code snippet in references/powers/voice-tts.md)
params: threshold 0.03; ratio 4–8; attack 20 ms; release 400 ms; bed ~ −31 LUFS under VO

what: تسليم الصوت عند −14 LUFS وذروة حقيقية ≤ −1 dBFS، مع فحص آلي للطول والصيغة. / Deliver at −14 LUFS with true peak ≤ −1 dBFS, verified by an automatic gate.
how: loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 (−16 for podcasts), 48 kHz stereo, AAC 192k, then `python3 kosif-tool/tools/verify_video.py film.mp4 --audio vo.wav --lufs -14`. Ran here: 11/11 PASS, −14.8 LUFS, TP −4.3 dBFS.
params: I −14 ±1.5 LUFS; TP ≤ −1 dBFS; ≥ 44.1 kHz; audio vs master ±50 ms

name_ar: وصل المقاطع كـ WAV لا MP3
name_en: Join chunks as PCM, not MP3 copy
what: ضمّ قطع التعليق بعد فكها إلى WAV؛ نسخ MP3 مباشرة يضيف حشوًا يزيح توقيت الكلمات. / Concatenate narration chunks after decoding to WAV; MP3 stream-copy adds padding that drifts word timings.
how: Decode each chunk to 48 kHz PCM, concat with the concat filter (or concat demuxer on WAVs), then transcribe the JOINED file once — never add per-chunk transcripts with offsets.
params: MP3 encoder delay ≈ 1105 samples per chunk

name_ar: محادثة صوتية عربية لحظية عبر WebRTC
what: المتصفح يفتح اتصال WebRTC ويرسل عرض SDP إلى Worker يضيف المفتاح وإعدادات الجلسة، ثم صوت باتجاهين وقناة أحداث. / The browser opens WebRTC, posts its SDP offer to a Cloudflare Worker that adds the key and session config, then streams two-way audio with an events channel.
how: voice.js createVoiceAssistant().start(); worker POST /api/realtime/session → realtime calls with model gpt-realtime, input transcription gpt-4o-mini-transcribe (language ar), server_vad turn detection, output voice 'marin'; session.update injects file context (≤ 14000 chars); fallback = deterministic router VOICE-48. Needs OPENAI_API_KEY as a Worker secret.
params: Content-Type application/sdp; SDP ≤ 200000 bytes; data channel 'oai-events'; context ≤ 14000 chars

what: إذا تكلم المستخدم أثناء كلام المساعد، تنقلب الواجهة إلى الاستماع ويُلغى الرد. / If the user speaks while the assistant talks, the UI flips to listening and the response is cancelled.
how: On event input_audio_buffer.speech_started while state = speaking → emit 'interrupted'; interrupt() sends {type:'response.cancel'} over the data channel.

what: موجه قواعد يحول الكلام العربي المطبع إلى تنقل بين الشاشات وإجابات حالة، دون اختراع أرقام. / A rule router mapping normalised Arabic utterances to screen navigation and status answers, never inventing numbers.
how: routeIntent(transcript, context, api) with VIEW_WORDS (18 views) and has() keyword checks; unknown → guidance reply. Ran here: node --test tests/voice.test.js → 3/3 pass (navigation, status, unknown).
params: 18 view vocabularies; 3 tests

what: كرة 44 بكسل تروي حالة الجلسة: خاملة بنفسجية، تستمع فيروزية بثلاث حلقات، تفكر بدوامة مخروطية، تتكلم بنبض تنفس. / A 44 px orb narrating the session: idle violet, listening teal with three rings, thinking conic swirl, speaking breathing pulse.
how: Set data-state on #voiceOrb (idle|listening|thinking|speaking); keyframes orb-pulse, orb-spin, orb-breathe. (code snippet in references/powers/voice-tts.md)
params: idle radial at 35% 35% #c4b5fd → #6d28d9 60% → #1e1b4b; listening #99f6e4 → #0f766e → #042f2e + 8 px halo rgba(15,118,110,.18), rings 1.8 s ease-out scale .6 → 1.9 delays 0/.6/1.2 s; thinking conic #a78bfa,#6d28d9,#0f766e spin 1.2 s linear; speaking scale 1.1 breathe 1 s + 10 px halo

what: زر ميكروفون عائم بتدرج يطلق حلقة متسعة طوال الجلسة الحية. / A floating gradient mic button that emits an expanding ring while the session is live.
how: .voice-fab.live .voice-fab-ring { animation: voice-ring 1.6s ease-out infinite }.
params: FAB 60 px (KOSIF4 50 px); gradient 140deg #6d28d9 → #0f766e (KOSIF4 135deg #453556 → #395744); ring scale 1 → 1.7, opacity .8 → 0; hover −2 px, scale 1.03

what: يُفتح الميكروفون بإلغاء الصدى وكبت الضوضاء والتحكم الآلي بالكسب. / The mic opens with echo cancellation, noise suppression and auto gain.
how: navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:{echoCancellation:true, noiseSuppression:true, autoGainControl:true}}). For a VO take meant for the film, turn autoGainControl OFF (it pumps) and clean later with VOICE-39.

what: مساعد صغير يسجل MediaStream إلى Blob ويطلق تنزيل الملف. / A small helper that records a MediaStream into a Blob and triggers a file download.
how: createAudioRecorder(stream) → {start, stop(): Promise<Blob>}; downloadAudioBlob(blob, 'kosif-response.webm') revokes the object URL after 1000 ms. Convert to WAV with ffmpeg before sync work.
params: default mime audio/webm; revoke delay 1000 ms

what: لا اسم شخص حقيقي ولا صوته ولا «بأسلوب فلان» في توليد الصوت أو الموسيقى؛ الاستنساخ بموافقة فقط، والإفصاح عن الصوت المصطنع حيث يلزم. / No real person's name, voice or 'in the style of' prompt for voice or music; clone only with consent; disclose synthetic voices where required.
how: Describe timbre in words instead (deep, warm, slightly raspy, mid-40s, measured). Keep the consent record next to any cloned voice id.

name_en: No audio claim without a receipt
what: لا تقل إن الصوت وُلّد أو سُمع إلا ومعك ملف ومدة وجهارة مقاسة. / Never claim audio was rendered (or heard) without a file, a duration and a measured loudness.
how: Report: path, ffprobe duration, integrated LUFS, true peak, and words.json count. Style observations that say 'not listened to' stay labelled that way.

what: انزع markdown وHTML وخزّن الأسطر المكررة قبل الدفع بالحرف. / Strip markdown/HTML and cache repeated lines before paying per character.
how: Pre-clean text; cache key sha256(voice:model:settings:text); re-render only changed lines (the Voice Director's selective re-render follows the same idea).
params: saves 5–15 % characters; 80–95 % cache hits on iterations
